control._why: Boros Charm gives reach and saves the board from wipes, Get Lost answers planeswalkers and enchantments, Roku and Dragonhawk give card advantage. Cuts cheap creature removal and lifegain.

midrange._why: More creature removal and permanent answers vs a creature midrange deck; cuts the weakest threats.

aggro._why: Cheap answers to early threats (Seam Rip, Solitary Cell, Sheltered by Ghosts). Cuts the weakest creatures. (added 2026-11-23 for the meta round robin)

graveyard._why: Added 2026-11-26: their best against graveyard-based aggro decks (graveyard hate, cards that stop enter triggers, cheap removal, sweepers). All 3 Rest in Peace, plus cheap exile and removal for 1-3 drops. Cuts the slowest dragons and Voice of Victory.
